SELF_HELP_STOP.detail: participant-instructions.md closes with 'What this packet is not': 'This is a prepared copy of an official Massachusetts Trial Court form. It is not legal advice, it is not filed for you, and it does not decide whether your record can be expunged. The court's own instruction sheet sets out what the judge must find, and only the judge makes that finding.' The guide additionally carries the route record's own hand-off line, 'Hand off when the district attorney opposes or a hearing is set.' Nothing in either fixture or the guide asserts an outcome, an eligibility determination or a review approval.

FILING_DESTINATION.detail: Two independent records agree and the guide carries both. The form's own page 2, which I read out of the delivered bytes: 'You should file this petition in the clerk's office in the court where the case was heard.' The track registry for ma-expunge-k: venue 'Statewide form, court-specific filing. File in the clerk's office in the court where the case was heard', destination kind clerk, detail 'Boston Municipal, District, Juvenile or Superior Court, per the form's department checkboxes.' The guide quotes both. The four department boxes that carry the destination are correctly identified — see ROUTE_OPTIONS, where I re-derived every one from geometry.

SERVICE.detail: The service obligation is the district attorney's copy and the guide states it from the form's own instruction sheet, quoted verbatim: 'You must provide a copy of this petition and any documents that you file with the petition to the District Attorney's Office that prosecuted the case on or before the day that this petition is filed in the court.' The two method boxes and the date are left blank with a stated reason — 'this platform will not certify an act that has not happened' — which is correct: the sentence on the form is a past-tense assertion by the signer. No service rule, recipient or deadline is invented: the guide says in terms that the route record records no further service recipient, method or timing. The two method boxes are correctly identified by geometry: CheckBox7[0] at x 20.84 is 'by delivering a copy in hand' and CheckBox8[0] at x 182.84 is 'by mailing a copy via first class mail', which is what the printed line at that y actually reads left to right.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.detail: Two committed controlling records make obtaining a CORI a required-before-filing act and the delivered guide never discloses it. (1) data/record-clearing/legal-design-packet-set-manifests.json, packetSet ma-expunge-k-set, participantActionRequired[0]: kind obtain_document, requirement required, requiredBeforeFiling true, obtainedFrom 'Massachusetts Department of Criminal Justice Information Services', description 'Obtain Your own CORI from the Department of Criminal Justice Information Services. Request your personal CORI from DCJIS.' The same string is the first entry of that packetSet's requiredBeforeFiling array. (2) data/record-clearing/legal-design-track-registry.json, track ma-expunge-k, packetSet.participantActionRequired[0] carries the identical item. participantActionRequired[1] is the paired confirm_answer item, 'Check your answer to "What is the docket number?" against Your own CORI ... and correct the packet if they disagree', also requiredBeforeFiling true. WHAT THE DELIVERED GUIDE ACTUALLY SAYS: I read participant-instructions.md end to end and grepped it. It contains three references to a CORI and all three are as an OPTIONAL ALTERNATIVE SOURCE to copy from, never as a document to obtain — line 64 'Write in the docket number and the charges from your own court papers or your CORI', line 85 'copied from your own court papers or from your CORI', line 87 'listed from your own court papers or CORI'. There is no step directing the participant to obtain it, no 'documents you must obtain first' section anywhere in the guide, and the only occurrence of 'Department of Criminal Justice Information' (line 7) is inside a quotation from the court's instruction sheet about which agencies must DESTROY records on expungement — the opposite role. DCJIS is never named. A participant who follows the guide's own numbered eight-step list and holds their court papers never obtains a CORI at all, and never performs the confirm_answer cross-check, because neither is stated. THE FAMILY'S OWN CLAIM AND WHY IT READS CLEAN: reports/blanks-left-for-the-participant.json asserts everyRequiredBeforeFilingItemIsDisclosed true with disclosedIn participant-instructions.md, but its requiredBeforeFiling array holds 16 entries and every one of them is a FORM BLANK on the petition face; the controlling records' seven participant-action strings are outside its scope, so the assertion is true of a narrower set than its name claims. This is the same defect shape and the same standard on which this lane failed co_petition_seal_arrest-set on 20260909b, where the record's obtain_document item (the CBI criminal-history report) was likewise absent from the guide while the guide mentioned the agency in a different role.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.detail: THE TEXT BLANKS PASS AND THE SELECTIONS FAIL. First the part that passes, so the failure is not overstated: the field map carries 57 refusals dispositioned REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING and I found all 57 of their effectiveLabel strings verbatim in participant-instructions.md, and both of the controlling manifest's obtain_document items - supporting evidence of trafficking, and the certified ALEA criminal record - are disclosed as numbered steps 1 and 2 of 'Do these before you file'. WHAT FAILS: the official CR-65 prints, in the delivered bytes, three elections it marks mandatory, and the packet neither makes them nor tells the participant to. (1) Packet page 6, under the printed heading 'I swear or affirm, under the penalty of perjury:', item '(3) (Select one of the following):' offers '[ ] that I have not previously applied for an expungement in this or any other jurisdiction.' and '[ ] that I have previously filed for an expungement.' In all four delivered fixtures BOTH boxes are blank. I confirmed this at appearance level by rendering delivered page 6 at 130 dpi and reading it. (2) Packet page 5 prints 'Attached to this Petition are: (Petition must include either item 1 or item 2; All Petitions must include item 3.)' over three boxes - certified record of arrest, certified record of disposition, and certified official criminal record from ALEA. All three are blank in all four fixtures, so neither the either-1-or-2 requirement nor the always-required item 3 is elected. NOW THE DISCLOSURE: I grepped both instruction files for 'select one', 'previously applied', 'previously filed', 'pro se', 'granted', 'denied', 'penalty of perjury', 'swear' and 'attach'. The only hit in either file is the closing line of filing-instructions.md, 'Do not sign or date the petition until every required blank and every attachment is complete' - which names no election and no attachment. Neither file names item (3), neither names the attachment boxes, and neither names the 'was [ ] granted [ ] denied' pair or the '[ ] pro se (Not represented by an attorney)' box, all of which are also blank on page 6. THE MECHANISM THAT KEEPS THE COUNTERS GREEN: the field map holds 50 selection-control refusals and 46 of them carry the identical boilerplate reason, 'A genuine participant election not determined by this route. This petition elects one statutory ground only.' That sentence is factually untrue of the page-5 attachment boxes, of the page-6 sworn select-one, of granted/denied and of pro se - none of them is a statutory ground. Worse, all 50 carry an effectiveLabel that is only the raw AcroForm field name ('Participant choice: Check Box2.0 (selection)'), so the record never states what any of these blanks says on the paper, and I confirmed that 0 of the 50 labels appears anywhere in participant-instructions.md. Every one of the 50 is recorded with requiredBeforeFiling false, which drops the mandatory ones out of the required-before-filing set entirely and is why nothing downstream can see them. A participant who follows this guide files a sworn CR-65 whose perjury clause has an unelected item (3) and whose attachment certification is unelected.

PAGE_ORDER.detail: Verified from each delivered page's own printed footer rather than from any manifest. In all four fixtures the order is CR-65 printed pages 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 followed by C-10-CRIMINAL printed pages 1 of 3, 2 of 3, 3 of 3 - eleven pages, ascending within each document, primary filing before certificate of service before fee waiver, which is the manifest's own component order 1, 2, 3. The sections fall where the source puts them: Section I on packet pages 1-2, Sections II and III on 2-3, Sections IV and V on 3-4. No page is duplicated, transposed or dropped, and the delivered page count equals the sum of the two sources' page counts (8 + 3).

ROUTE_OPTIONS.detail: The four route-determined selections the field map records are all carried out in the delivered bytes and all land on the correct printed sentence, which I verified by reading the text around each tick rather than by trusting the checkbox name. (1) and (2) are the statutory variant: canonical--misdemeanor and boundary--misdemeanor tick the box beside 'I can prove by a preponderance of the evidence that I was a victim of human trafficking, and committed the MISDEMEANOR offense, violation, traffic violation, or municipal ordinance violation...' in Section I on packet page 2, and canonical--felony and boundary--felony tick the box beside 'I can prove ... and committed the FELONY offense during the period I was being trafficked' in Section III on packet page 3. Each fixture ticks exactly one box in the petition, which is what CR-65 itself demands: 'Check ONLY one (1) of the eight (8) options below'. (3) The C-10 caption elects 'STATE OF ALABAMA' rather than 'MUNICIPALITY OF', matching the circuit-court filing. (4) The C-10 elects the third of its three printed requests, waiver of the expungement petition administrative filing fee, and leaves the court-appointed-attorney and ignition-interlock requests blank with stated reasons. The out-of-scope refusals also carry real reasons rather than boilerplate: Section IV is named and declined as an owner scoping determination. I ALSO CHECKED THE NEAR-CLONE QUESTION THE BRIEF ASKS TO BE RAISED EVEN WHEN THE CHECK CLEARS IT. Whitespace-normalised packet text of the felony and misdemeanor fixtures differs by exactly one character in each pair, and I diffed them: the entire difference is that the tick moves from Section I option 8 to Section III option 8. That is the correct and complete expression of the two statutes, so the near-identity is the right answer here rather than a defect. Recorded as raised and answered. SEPARATELY RECORDED, NOT SCORED HERE: 46 of the 50 selection-control refusals carry no printed label at all, only the raw AcroForm field name, and a single boilerplate reason that is untrue of several of them; that finding is scored under REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING, where its consequence falls.

REPEATING_ROWS.detail: CR-65 carries one genuinely repeating structure and several paired line blanks, and both are handled. The repeating structure is the certificate of service, which the form itself describes: 'A separate form should be filled out and signed by the person who served the party. Include as many copies of this page as necessary to show service on all parties, persons, or entities.' The packet delivers exactly one copy of that page, blank, and participant-instructions.md states the repetition rule - 'Use a separate CR-65 page 7 certificate of service for each recipient' - so the participant is told to duplicate it. The paired blanks (the charge, the grounds, the arresting agency and any detaining agency each get a line 1 and a line 2) are all uniformly blank in all four fixtures and all eight labels appear individually in the guide's 'Blanks you must fill in' list, so no row is half-written and none is silently dropped. incompleteRows 0.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.detail: The fee figure is not invented: it is carried by the controlling record - AL.memo.json rules.fees, '$500, or C-10-Criminal where indigency is claimed' - and it is also printed on the delivered paper itself, which I read out of packet page 4: 'If the Court does not determine the Petitioner to be indigent and does not waive the $500.00 filing fee...'. The waiver instrument the record names, C-10-Criminal Affidavit of Substantial Hardship and Order, is the fee_waiver component and it is delivered. The election on it is correct and the sworn part of it is handled honestly: the packet ticks the printed request for waiver of the expungement petition administrative filing fee, and participant-instructions.md step 5 tells the participant 'If you are NOT claiming financial hardship, remove the affidavit from the packet and pay the filing fee instead - the hardship statement is yours, and you make it by signing it.' Every one of the roughly forty financial blanks on the affidavit (income, expenses, assets) is left blank and every one is disclosed individually in the guide's list, and the affidavit's order page is left entirely to the judge, which filing-instructions.md states in terms.
